title: THE FOOTING DECISION TREE
question: the pre-registered set of measurements that picks the a0 scale, given the staircase (G133) + the n-wedge (G183)

basis.G133_staircase: DE 9.3619e-11 < RAR 1.200-1.2457e-10 < MIGHTEE 1.69-1.8433e-10; a0_MIGHTEE free = 1.843e-10 +- 2.42e-11, rms 0.190 -> 0.129 dex; rejects a0_DE at 5.2 sigma log; max honest systematic closure 0.097 dex
basis.G183_n_wedge: deep n ~ 1.0-1.66 amplitude / 1.20+-0.06 slope vs full-curve n=2.000; pooled n-free fit n*=3.161+-0.347 a0*=3.084e-11 (outside n<=2 bound +3.3sigma); a0(z) G011 closes 1-2% d_BIC+150.1; environmental/EFE rejected G03D 0.692->0.534; seesaw n(a0)=s/a0 rejected 8 sigma; no n<=2 family reconciles
basis.G080_btfr: z~2.5 discriminator: flat 0.00 dex vs rising +0.33 dex (Lambda-CDM-native), +-0.13-dex floor, 1 clean point = 20:1, 4 objects = 5 sigma
basis.G166/G172: shape is footing-invariant (slope 0.988+-0.020, deep exponent 1/2, 2/3 law, p*=0.99, -2.218 envelope; four exact); only the normalization (a0) differs; DE anchor CMB-consistent Omega(9.3619e-11)=0.6849 in (0.68,0.69) 0.03% from Planck

a_ONE_SCALE_DE.killed_by: K1: DR4 ridge at the RAR scale

b_ONE_SCALE_RAR.killed_by: K2: a clean MIGHTEE 0.13-dex read at a0_DE

c_TWO_SCALE_EFFECTIVE.killed_by: K2 (deep closes at a0_DE) or K1 (ridge at a0_DE)

K1.fires: DR4 ridge at the RAR scale (E6/E7 gamma_v 10-30 kAU; vertical slab; funnel) at pre-registered sigma, Dec 2026

K2.fires: a clean MIGHTEE 0.13-dex read at a0_DE (pressure-corrected rotation, honest M/L, 100+ deep rings)

K3.fires: a0* runs with M_b at > 3 sigma in the deep dwarfs

kill_rules.note: K1 and K2 are mutually exclusive singles that PICK a branch; firing together (ridge at RAR AND deep clean at a0_DE) FORCE the two-scale/effective reading (c)

verdicts.V1_branch_table: three exhaustive mutually-exclusive branches with the decisive measurement each (see branches above)
verdicts.V2_priority_order: 1 MIGHTEE (free, K2) -> 2 z~2.5 BTFR (20:1, discriminator) -> 3 DR4 ridge (Dec, K1) -> 4 tSZ phantom zone (shape confirm) -> 5 WALLABY pair-break (shape, catalog-limited)
verdicts.V3_honest_statement: the footing is resolvable by the registered tests; the first to fire wins the scale. A clean MIGHTEE 0.13-dex read at a0_DE wins ONE-scale-DE (K2); the DR4 ridge at the RAR scale wins/forecloses (K1); the z~2.5 BTFR zero point (flat@DE / flat@RAR / rising +0.33, 20:1 per point, 4 for 5 sigma) picks one- vs two-scale; a >3-sigma M_b run of a0* forces two-scale and hands the framework its open task (deriving a0_c = 1.54-1.66e-10 SPARC-end / 3.05-3.63e-10 MIGHTEE-end).

checks.note: all branch measurements and kill-rules reference the committed G133/G166/G172/G183/G080/G173/G100 numbers; no new data fit, pre-registered decision structure only
